title: Do Not Sell My Information
subtitle: HappyMom does not sell your personal information. Nevertheless, in accordance with California law, you may exercise your right to opt-out of the sale and sharing of your personal information.

optout.title: One-Click Browser-Based Opt-Out
optout.description: Click the button below to immediately opt-out of all data collection and sharing for marketing purposes occurring on this browser.

commitment.title: Privacy Commitment
commitment.content: HappyMom clearly states that we do not sell or rent client personal information to third parties for profit. We use client information solely for our inherent business purposes: improving service quality and matching caregivers.
commitment.additional: Since the definition of 'sale' under legal definitions can be interpreted broadly, we operate this page to ensure California residents can clearly exercise their rights.

ccpa.title: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)
ccpa.content: The CCPA and CPRA grant California residents the right to opt-out of the 'sale' or 'sharing' of their personal information with third parties. HappyMom fully respects these rights and guarantees the same level of opt-out rights for all clients.

other.title: Other Opt-Out Methods
other.description: In addition to the one-click button above, you can directly communicate your opt-out intent through the following methods:

email.title: Email Request
email.content: Please send your name and contact information to {email}.

phone.title: Customer Service
phone.content: You can make a request to a representative via phone at {phone}.

footer: Identity verification may be required to process this request. We will guide you through the results within 15 business days of receiving the application. Last updated: May 3, 2024
